name: @spell-app/util
description: Helpers shared by @spell-app/ui, spell and the CLI:  generic ones (@proto, class, string, DOM) and spell's own (src/spell/)

scripts.review:
yarn ts && yarn lint:fix && yarn format && yarn test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'
scripts.ts:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TSC' && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && echo '<< TSC PASSED
'
scripts.lint:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT' && oxlint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 src && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'
scripts.lint:fix:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT --fix' && oxlint --fix src && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'
scripts.format:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> FORMATTING WITH OXFMT' && oxfmt . && echo '<< OXFMT PASSED
'
scripts.test:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TESTS' && vitest run && echo '<< TESTS PASSED
'
